title: Scheduled clock time
description: Replaces the countdown with the scheduled clock time (e.g. 22:43 instead of 3 min) for rows in PRÓXIMO/later state — the format most real transit signage defaults to, since it survives a glance away from the screen better than a decaying number. "ahora" and "SALIENDO" are left unchanged since they aren't clock-derived.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue eta formatting (etaMinutes → 'N min' / 'H h M min'); .arrival-row__eta, .arrival-row__eta-unit

changes.intent: Show the absolute time the bus is scheduled to leave rather than a countdown, so the number stays meaningful even if the viewer looks away and back.
changes.detail: Add a derived, detail-only `scheduledTime` field: `scheduledTime = format(now + etaMinutes, 'HH:mm')` using the same toLocaleTimeString('es-CR', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit', hour12:false}) call already used for the header clock. For any row not in the now/departing state, render `scheduledTime` in place of the countdown text. Rows in 'ahora' (etaMinutes===0) or 'SALIENDO' (departing) keep their existing label text unchanged.

changes.intent: A clock time has no min/h suffix, so the unit element renders nothing for these rows.
changes.detail: Only applies to rows now rendering scheduledTime; the unit span is simply omitted from the template for those rows rather than styled away, so this is a documentation note rather than a live override.
